title: S3 GetObject Body.toString() returns [object Object] or a stream instead of the file contents in AWS SDK v3
symptoms: TypeScript types Body as a union of Readable, ReadableStream and Blob
JSON.parse fails on the object you just downloaded
cause: In SDK v3 the Body is a runtime stream, not a Buffer as in v2. Later v3 releases attach helper methods to the stream that read it for you.
fix: Await Body.transformToString() or transformToByteArray(). Read it once, because the stream is consumed by the first read.
affected: AWS SDK for JavaScript v3, @aws-sdk/client-s3 all versions; transformToString exists in releases from late 2022 onward
